vector_contract.patches: Apply RFC 6902 JSON Patch operations in order to a deep copy of the named base fixture.

validation_layers.registry_schema: Validate the complete registry document against P2-09-46 Draft 2020-12 JSON Schema.
validation_layers.cross_record: Resolve type map keys, schema artifact references/hashes, Command IDs, Relationship IDs, geometry families/cardinality, lifecycle and Asset-link consistency.
validation_layers.compatibility: Verify legacy allowlists/pins, descriptor profile eligibility and explicit schema/semantics migration policy.
validation_layers.build_packaging: Verify all schema artifacts exist in the offline bundle, their exact bytes match lowercase SHA-256 pins, and no network/path traversal resolution occurs.

vector_contract.expected: valid means all checks in the vector's validation layer pass; invalid means the exact stable error_code is returned.
vector_contract.evidence: A runner must report vector ID, registry/format version, validator/compiler build, layer, actual error code, platform and pass/fail.
vector_contract.no_false_pass: JSON parsing, patch application or schema self-inspection alone is not a vector pass.

vectors.reason: The ten existing compact descriptors are explicitly tagged legacy_compact_v1 and retain their schema_version and semantics_id.
A descriptor without an explicit profile is rejected.
An unknown descriptor profile is rejected.
Registry format version 1 cannot be interpreted as V2.
The object_types map key must equal descriptor.type_key.

vectors.reason: A new type cannot use the legacy compact profile.
A complete typed_v2 descriptor carries metadata, identity, all three schema references and explicit policies.
Typed descriptors require a definition schema reference.
Typed descriptors require a runtime schema reference, including an explicit empty schema.
Typed descriptors require an Initial State schema reference.
Descriptor-pinned schema hash must match the schema artifact catalog entry.
Schema artifact paths must be repository-relative and cannot traverse outside the bundle root.
Schema artifact IDs are unique within the registry.
Every schema reference must resolve to exactly one bundled artifact.
Every Command capability must resolve to a registered Command descriptor.
V1 typed geometry roles are restricted to dimension 2.
A finite maximum cannot be lower than the declared minimum.
Geometry families must be supported by the Core Geometry contract.
Relationship participation must resolve to the Relationship registry.
Only the existing typed Asset-link tables are allowed.
Enabled child aggregates require an owner-scoped child identity namespace.
Child identity reuse is forbidden.
Unknown descriptor fields are rejected.
Legacy descriptors must retain their pinned schema_version and semantics_id unless an explicit migration is registered.
typed_v2 requires descriptor_schema_version 2 or later.
Each Command capability requires enabled, scope and policy.
A non-empty stable semantics_id is required.
The actual bundled schema bytes must match the pinned lowercase SHA-256 hash.
Changing display metadata alone does not change semantics_id or require a schema migration.
Legacy profile entries also reject unknown fields.
Lifecycle create/activate/deactivate references must agree with enabled Command capabilities.
Asset link required/role policy must agree with the payload and enabled Command contracts.
A deterministic meaning change requires a new semantics_id and explicit compatibility handling.

external_context.expected_behavior: reject because semantic meaning changed without a new semantics_id and explicit migration
